title: GL-05 — VPC segmentation
stopChargesPanel: Delete endpoints, associations, subnets, IGW detach, SG, NACL, route tables, then VPC.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on VPC segmentation; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Create the VPC
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.50.0.0/16 --query Vpc.VpcId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=vpc,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=workbook-gl05},{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05},{Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 modify-vpc-attribute --vpc-id $VpcId --enable-dns-hostnames '{"Value":true}'`.
Success: `$VpcId` is set.

steps.title: Create subnets
bullets: Run `$SubnetPub = aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id $VpcId --cidr-block 10.50.1.0/24 --availability-zone us-east-1a --query Subnet.SubnetId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=subnet,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05}]"`.

Run `$SubnetPriv = aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id $VpcId --cidr-block 10.50.2.0/24 --availability-zone us-east-1b --query Subnet.SubnetId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=subnet,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05}]"`.
Success: both subnet ids are set.

steps.title: Internet gateway and public routes
bullets: Run `$IgwId = aws ec2 create-internet-gateway --query InternetGateway.InternetGatewayId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=internet-gateway,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 attach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId --vpc-id $VpcId`.
Run `$PublicRouteTableId = aws ec2 create-route-table --vpc-id $VpcId --query RouteTable.RouteTableId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=route-table,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id $PublicRouteTableId --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id $IgwId`.
Run `$RtAssocPub = aws ec2 associate-route-table --route-table-id $PublicRouteTableId --subnet-id $SubnetPub --query AssociationId --output text`.
Success: public subnet has a default route to the IGW.

steps.title: Private route table and S3 endpoint
bullets: Run `$PrivateRouteTableId = aws ec2 create-route-table --vpc-id $VpcId --query RouteTable.RouteTableId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=route-table,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05}]"`.
Run `$RtAssocPriv = aws ec2 associate-route-table --route-table-id $PrivateRouteTableId --subnet-id $SubnetPriv --query AssociationId --output text`.

Run `$EndpointId = aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id $VpcId --service-name com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 --route-table-ids $PrivateRouteTableId --query VpcEndpoint.VpcEndpointId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=vpc-endpoint,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05}]"`.
Success: endpoint State is available.

steps.title: Security group and NACL
bullets: Run `$SgId = aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name workbook-gl05 --description "gl05" --vpc-id $VpcId --query GroupId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=security-group,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id $SgId --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 203.0.113.0/32` using your public /32.
Run `$CustomNaclId = aws ec2 create-network-acl --vpc-id $VpcId --query NetworkAcl.NetworkAclId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=network-acl,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-05}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id $CustomNaclId --ingress --rule-number 100 --protocol 6 --rule-action deny --cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --port-range From=22,To=22`.
Run `$NaclAssocId = aws ec2 describe-network-acls --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=$SubnetPriv --query 'NetworkAcls[0].Associations[0].NetworkAclAssociationId' --output text`.
Run `$DefaultNaclId = aws ec2 describe-network-acls --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VpcId Name=default,Values=true --query 'NetworkAcls[0].NetworkAclId' --output text`.
Run `aws ec2 replace-network-acl-association --association-id $NaclAssocId --network-acl-id $CustomNaclId`.
Success: private subnet uses the custom NACL.

steps.title: Verify no NAT
bullets: Run `aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filter Name=vpc-id,Values=$VpcId --query NatGateways`.
Success: the list is empty.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: VPC endpoint, NACL restore, route disassociation, subnets, IGW, SG, NACL, VPC
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-05` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-05 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-05 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-05. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Build a VPC with public and private subnets, security group, restrictive NACL, and an S3 gateway endpoint. No NAT gateway in this lab.
